{{External|rsc=Adamantite Plate Mail Body|rs|dw=Adamant Platebody}} {{Infobox Item |name = Adamant platebody |image = [[File:Adamant platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 16640 |weight = 11.339 |exchange = Yes |id = 1123 }} [[File:Adamant platebody detail.png|150px|left]] The '''adamant platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] with stat bonuses between [[Mithril platebody|mithril]] and [[Rune platebody|rune]]. It requires 30 [[Defence]] to equip and provides greater protection than an [[adamant chainbody]]. Like all [[Platebody|platebodies]], however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. Players with level 88 [[Smithing]] can make one by using 5 [[adamant bar|adamantite bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 312.5 [[experience]]. Smithing an adamant platebody is a requirement for the [[elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = +65 |dslash = +63 |dcrush = +55 |dmagic = -6 |drange = +63 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Adamant platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Adamant platebody equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 88 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 312.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Adamantite bar |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Adamant platebody }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Adamant platebody}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Adamant platebody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Adamant platebody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Adamant platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 October 2014 |update = Content Poll 25 - Batch 1 |poll = Old School Content Poll 25 |change = The high alchemy value of the adamant platebody has been increased from 7,680 coins to 9,984 coins to create a viable alternative to superheating for Smithing training. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Adamant platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Adamant platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Adamant platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Adamant platebody.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
